name: Defender for Cloud / Internet-exposed VMs vulnerable to remote code execution
text:
// Adapted from the exposure graph query examples on Microsoft Learn (https://learn.microsoft.com/security-exposure-management/query-enterprise-exposure-graph).
ExposureGraphNodes
| where set_has_element(Categories, "virtual_machine")
| extend RawData = NodeProperties.rawData
| where isnotnull(RawData.exposedToInternet)
| where isnotnull(RawData.vulnerableToRCE)
| project VmName = NodeName, NodeLabel, NodeId, ExposedToInternet = RawData.exposedToInternet, VulnerableToRCE = RawData.vulnerableToRCE
